title: Admin dashboard tables with sorting

requirements.text: Clicking a sortable column sorts ascending/descending, stably, numeric-aware and with nulls last
Sort state is exposed accessibly (aria-sort, labelled sort buttons, announced result status)
Rows are paginated, and the page is clamped when the data or filter changes
Users can search or filter rows, with distinct empty-dataset and no-match states
Cell content is rendered as escaped text
Large datasets sort and paginate on the server, with sort keys allow-listed (no raw column names in SQL)
The data endpoint behind the table refuses users without the admin permission with 401/403

evidence.name: table selection is immutable, stable, numeric-aware, case-insensitive, and null-last
table pagination, sorting, and searching update rows and accessible status together
table clamps pages after data changes
table pagination, sorting, and searching update rows
table escapes caller text and safely handles invalid page sizes

implementations.notes: Client-side only: sorting and paging run over rows already in the browser
Route guard for the table's data endpoint; wiring is the app's

notes: Server-side sorting/pagination is uncovered; capability:signed-cursors and capability:pagination-window are building blocks.
